A new beginning ✦ Our next chapter

To amazing
next chapters.

I’m so proud of you, Ash—for taking control of your life and building a future on your own terms.

You’ve worked hard for this new beginning, and I’m so happy we get to celebrate you moving in. I love you, admire you, and can’t wait to build what comes next together.

Welcome home, my love. ♡

Home feels even more like home with you here.
Always on your team. Always in your corner. ♡

All my love. All our tomorrows.
